description: Returns the HTS code's MFN/FTA base rate, ALL active chapter 99 rules (IEEPA/301/232 additional duties) matching the origin as verbatim text, and MPF/HMF fees. The LLM should walk the chapter-99 exception chains itself to stack the right duty layers, explain each step to the user, and always note this is an estimate.

hts_code.description: 8-10 digit HTS code, with or without dots

origin_country.description: Country of origin: ISO-3166 alpha-2 code (e.g. 'CN') or English country name (e.g. 'China')

quantity.description: Quantity in the code's units (No./Dz Pcs...) — needed for per-piece specific duties

weight_kg.description: Total weight (kg) — REQUIRED when the code carries a specific duty per kg (e.g. '12.4¢/kg')

name: calculate_tariff_scenario
title: Calculate tariff scenario
